note: cohort-level declarations. read at runtime, never guessed.
subject_id_note: the confounder axis. splitting below it leaks - the three subarrays per patient are consecutive 16um sections of one frozen block, near-duplicates in z. NMI(label, patient_id) must be computed before any coherence metric is believed.
backend_note: independent, and the first is not the server's. client_model_backend names the endpoint the CONNECTING CLIENT calls - this server ships no model and holds no key - while compute_backend says where encoders run. neither implies the other, and both fail closed when absent.

provenance.source: Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.8135721 (Wang et al. 2024, Nat Commun 15:10232)

declaration_note: every field a PERSON declares about the cohort lives here; every field a person declares about a PLATFORM lives in platform.json.
preflight_note: these five answer the compute contract's preflight gates, and they are declared AS BUILT - they reproduce the published grid rather than describing what one would choose today. with them present the graph fires zero preflight gates and this cohort runs unattended, which is what makes it usable as the end-to-end fixture.
below_floor_provenance: drop is what the published numbers assume, not a preference. data/embeddings/novae_niche_full/run_manifest.json records skip_too_small_for_novae=19 against 281 enumerated, 262 parquets written (241 ok + 21 pre-existing); the niche join carries 259 subarrays. the preflight gate recomputes the same 19 from the fresh canonical ingest against the encoder's declared min_units of 512 - two independent paths to one number. below_floor_policy=mark is a DECLARED ALTERNATIVE and has not been run: it would change the cohort, so it is its own arm, the same way the 128um tile is in platform.json#he_tile.declared_alternative.

below_floor_policy.why: keeps all 280 subarrays and marks the 19 as below-floor rather than removing them, so the funnel shows them and any metric can exclude them downstream instead of at extraction.
below_floor_policy.question: does including below-floor subarrays, marked, change H1?
